findings.statement: Entity type is Individual (sole proprietor) in Connecticut, where no state entity registration is expected for a sole proprietor operating under the owner's own name, so absence of a filing is not adverse. The Connecticut Secretary of the State online business search at service.ct.gov could not be loaded by automation in this session, so no registry record was retrieved either way. No public Norwalk mobile-food-vendor permit roster could be located; searches surfaced only the Norwalk ordinance requirement that no food handling establishment operate without a licence from the Director of Health, not a list of holders.
findings.establishes: No registration is expected for a sole proprietor; the CT registry was not reachable and no Norwalk permit list is published, so legal status is neither confirmed nor contradicted.

findings.statement: A food truck requires a health permit and a physical pitch, yet no independent footprint for this business as a Dominican food truck in or near Norwalk CT was found. The FoodTrucksIn directory for Norwalk CT lists fourteen trucks and does not include El Callejon or any Dominican truck. Separate searches of Yelp, Facebook, Instagram and Best Food Trucks returned no Norwalk CT listing; the only similarly named food businesses found are in Hawaiian Gardens CA, Houston TX, Santa Fe NM and Westchester NY, all unrelated.
findings.establishes: No independent listing or social presence places this food truck in Norwalk CT.

findings.statement: The statement descriptor on this account is the representative's own name, so there is no descriptor/representative mismatch to score. Searches for the representative together with the business name and Norwalk CT found no state filing, permit record, owner reply on a review site, social page or news item tying the representative to this food truck; a separate Norwalk food-truck operator sharing the representative's surname appears in local coverage but runs a different truck in a different cuisine and is not a link to this business, so it is not treated as a contradiction. No scam, complaint or fraud report naming the representative was found. Note that the sibling Company account acct_1UWNnw59ZZQz3S3p, opened from the same email address 1.5 hours later, names the same representative and does match the sole principal on an active Connecticut LLC filing. Identity documents and bank ownership are verified only by Stripe (status: verified).
findings.establishes: The representative could not be tied to this particular account's business in any public source, and nothing contradicts the representative.

findings.statement: No website is declared on the account and none was found. The email handle elcallejonfoodtruck25@gmail.com coheres with the stated trade name and trade and does not describe payment collection; the statement descriptor is the representative's personal name rather than a random string, which is normal for a sole proprietor. Free-mail-only contact with no site or social handle leaves the merchant unreachable through any channel the business itself controls.
findings.establishes: No website exists but the email handle and descriptor are coherent with the declared business.

findings.statement: MCC 5812 (eating places / restaurants) is internally coherent with the declared product description, a Dominican street-food truck, and with a mobile food vendor generally. However, no observable menu, listing, social page or review for this specific business was found, so the coherence rests entirely on self-declared data and could not be confirmed against anything the business is seen doing. Nothing in the name or description describes payment collection itself and no digital-goods mismatch is present. Note the sibling account for the apparent same business carries MCC 5814.
findings.establishes: The MCC fits the declared trade, but there is no observable activity to confirm it against.

findings.statement: No dated independent presence of any length was found: no reviews, directory listings, event or market vendor pages, local news coverage, BBB record or filings referring to an El Callejon Dominican food truck in Norwalk or elsewhere in Connecticut. No scam, complaint or fraud reports about the business or the representative were found either, so there is nothing adverse on record, only an absence of history.
findings.establishes: No independent history, positive or negative, exists for this business.

evidenceNeeded: Norwalk Department of Health mobile food vendor / itinerant food vendor permit - request the permit number and issue date directly from the merchant and confirm with the Norwalk Health Department, since no public roster exists.

Manual check of the Connecticut Secretary of the State business search at service.ct.gov/business/s/onlinebusinesssearch for any trade-name or entity filing matching El Callejon - the portal blocked automated retrieval.
Facebook or Instagram handle for the truck, plus photos of the truck with signage and a recent pitch location or event schedule.

Resolve the duplicate account: a second Stripe account, acct_1UWNnw59ZZQz3S3p ('El callejon Dominican food truck', Company, MCC 5814), was opened from the same email address with the same representative roughly 1.5 hours after this one - confirm which account is intended to transact and close or merge the other.
Food truck vehicle registration or commissary agreement evidencing a real operating unit.
summary: This is the Individual-entity half of a duplicate pair: a second account for the apparent same Norwalk CT Dominican food truck was opened from the identical email address 1.5 hours later as a Company, with the same representative. This account carries no declared website and no independent public footprint of any kind - absent from the FoodTrucksIn Norwalk directory, from Yelp's Norwalk Dominican listings, and from Facebook, Instagram, local news and food-truck booking platforms. Total risk is 10 points, all from the operating dimension, because a food truck requires a health permit and a physical pitch and a complete absence of listings is a real gap rather than a neutral one; the declared MCC, email handle and statement descriptor are internally coherent and nothing adverse was found. The sibling Company account is the better-evidenced of the two (it matches an active Connecticut LLC filing), so the operational priority is deciding which account transacts, obtaining the Norwalk health permit, and closing the other.
